district: Mount Shasta Union Elementary School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Mount Shasta Union Elementary School District to issue $9.1 million in bonds to repair or replace roofs, plumbing, electrical, and heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems and to upgrade emergency communication systems and fire alarms, repaid by property taxes levied at an average below $25 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: Authorizes $59 million in school bonds and levies a property tax to fund safety and facility improvements.
tax.quote: authorizing $59,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $28 per $100,000 of assessed value ($4,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: Provides local bond funding to upgrade safety and infrastructure across district elementary and middle schools.
schools.quote: To provide safe elementary/ middle schools by upgrading to current earthquake/ building safety codes; improving school security, classroom locks, fencing, lighting, emergency communications, and cameras; and upgrading fire safety, alarms, smoke detectors, sprinklers, and evacuation routes; shall Oakley Union Elementary School District's measure be adopted authorizing $59,000,000 in bonds at legal rates

tax.text: Maintains current property tax rates by declining to authorize the new school bonds.
tax.quote: authorizing $59,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $28 per $100,000 of assessed value ($4,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: Rejects the bond funding for the school district's facilities.
